data.notes: September 2026 in Malta is anchored by destination-festival weekends spanning drum and bass, R&B, dancehall, house and Desi pop.

events.title: Breaking Borders 2026
events.summary: The Desi destination festival returns to Malta with Karan Aujla, AP Dhillon, Jasmine Sandlas, Miss Pooja, Panjabi MC, Sukha, The PropheC and more listed on Ticketmaster.

events.title: WAH Malta 2026
events.summary: Worried About Henry brings a three-day drum and bass takeover to UNO Malta, with Hedex, Hybrid Minds, Shy FX, Wilkinson, Camo & Krooked b2b Mefjus and Kings of the Rollers named by the venue.

events.title: RNB & Slow Jams Malta 2026
events.summary: RnB & Slow Jams returns to Malta for a third edition, billed as five nights of sun, sea and R&B from Wednesday 9 to Monday 14 September 2026.

events.title: Freedom Street Europe 2026
events.summary: Freedom Street Europe returns to Malta for a four-day dancehall and Caribbean-culture takeover, with Vybz Kartel vs Mavado listed across the Gaza vs Gully nights.

events.title: Liquid Spirit Gozo 2026: Legacy and Love
events.summary: Liquid Spirit Gozo is a boutique dance music festival across Gozo settings, focused on soulful music, vocal and deep house, R&B, funk, boogie and classic house.

events.title: Rock 4 Hope 2026: I POOH
events.summary: Italian group I POOH play live at Malta Fairs & Conventions Centre as part of Rock 4 Hope 2026.

events.title: FUSE Malta 2026
events.summary: FUSE Malta returns for three days of music, sun and sea, transforming multiple island locations into an immersive sound-focused festival weekend.

events.title: Forward Motion Malta 2026: On the Rock Festival
events.summary: Forward Motion returns to Malta with On the Rock Festival, a four-day programme of deep, soulful and bumpy house across open-air island venues and boat parties.
